properties.name: camel.dataformat.gzip-deflater.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the gzipDeflater data format. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.gzip-deflater.max-decompressed-size
properties.description: Set the maximum decompressed size of the data (in bytes). The default value if not specified corresponds to 1 gigabyte. An IOException is thrown if the decompressed size exceeds this amount. Set to -1 to disable setting a maximum decompressed size.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.zip-deflater.compression-level
properties.description: Compression level to use (0-9). -1 is default compression, 0 is no compression, and 9 is the best compression.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.zip-deflater.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the zipDeflater data format. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.zip-deflater.max-decompressed-size
properties.description: Set the maximum decompressed size of the data (in bytes). The default value if not specified corresponds to 1 gigabyte. An IOException is thrown if the decompressed size exceeds this amount. Set to -1 to disable setting a maximum decompressed size.
